text: the prop just falls through the height field still i am trying to put a tree on a hill and it doesnt work
resolution: The tree on the hill shipped buried because the bake's terrain lift sampled only state.world.landforms, and the live painted hill exists ONLY in the map session's floor height grids — measured on the user's own map: at the treeCypress anchor landformGroundTopAt said 0.00 while the floor grid said 9.64m. Fix: worldColliders.paintedFloorTopAt now owns the painted-floor walkable-surface law (flat chunk = level + 0.1 slab top, relief/road chunk = the height grid — exactly the surface the shipped colliders stand you on), and packageMap joins it with the landform tops into ONE bakeTerrainTopAt used by BOTH lifts (the building flat-pad lift and the per-prop lift), so render, colliders, interactables, and dynamic-body anchors all rest on the painted terrain. Proof: the user's tree now bakes its instance rows at y=10.8+ on the 9.64m hill (decoded from a real bake), P4 worldColliders 5/5, rjit game shot GREEN.
